requirements.statement: A valid STRH, LDRH, LDRSB, or LDRSH emits a byte or halfword memory-request intent only when its ARM condition passes, with operation kind, effective address, load/store direction, signedness, and store halfword derived from the instruction and source register.
A condition-passing valid post-index or W-bit pre-index miscellaneous transfer emits a pending base-writeback value; preparation does not mutate architectural state.

A condition-passing unaligned halfword miscellaneous transfer is reported as UNPREDICTABLE and emits no constrained request intent; a failed condition causes no access and therefore no alignment behavior.
